schema.title: Public Company Reporting Window Finder Input
schema.description: Five modes. resolve and qualify and timing take company identifiers. universe and season take filters. Every array field accepts a JSON array, a comma separated string, or a single value, because Clay sends every input as a string.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: resolve returns identity and venue. qualify adds a listed status verdict. timing returns fiscal year end, reporting cadence, the next obligated event and your outreach window. universe builds a company list from filters. season returns reporting load per week or month.
enumTitles: qualify: is this account publicly listed
timing: fiscal year end, next event, outreach window
universe: build a company list from filters

company_domain.title: Company Domain
company_domain.description: A single bare domain, e.g. stripe.com. The Clay column shape. Used by resolve, qualify and timing.

company_domains.title: Company Domains (batch)
company_domains.description: Many domains at once. Used by resolve, qualify and timing.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Exchange tickers, e.g. NWLG. Matched against the primary ticker and every venue listing.

ciks.title: SEC CIKs
ciks.description: SEC Central Index Keys, with or without leading zeros.

company_names.title: Company Names
company_names.description: Legal or trading names. Matched on a normalized name. Former names are not available: the alias table carries tickers and ISINs only.

operating_companies_only.title: Operating Companies Only
operating_companies_only.description: Drop funds, trusts and other non operating entities. Sent as a string for Clay compatibility.

exclude_blank_checks.title: Exclude Blank Check Shells
exclude_blank_checks.description: Drop pre deal SPACs. Separate from the operating company filter: a blank check shell is flagged as an operating company and passes every ordinary firmographic filter.

listed_only.title: Keep Only Listed Companies
listed_only.description: qualify mode. Keep only rows proven to be publicly listed.

suppress_listed.title: Suppress Listed Companies
suppress_listed.description: qualify mode. Remove companies proven to be publicly listed, for anyone selling only into private companies. It removes what we can prove is listed; it does not warrant that the remainder is private.

assume_unmatched_is_private.title: Treat an Unmatched Company as Private
assume_unmatched_is_private.description: qualify mode. By default an unmatched company returns is_listed null, because a non match may mean the company is private OR that we do not hold its domain. Set true to opt into reading a non match as private, which sets is_listed false.

foreign_private_issuer.title: Foreign Private Issuer
foreign_private_issuer.description: Filter on foreign private issuer status.

us_registrant_only.title: US SEC Registrants Only
us_registrant_only.description: Keep only companies carrying an SEC CIK.

country_codes.title: Country Codes
country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. US, GB, FR.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Shorthand for a set of venues and countries: us, uk, eu. Widens an explicit exchange or country filter rather than replacing it.

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.description: SEC SIC descriptions, e.g. Pharmaceutical Preparations. Populated on roughly 65 percent of the publishable universe.

public_float_bands.title: Public Float Bands
public_float_bands.description: micro, small, mid, large, mega, unknown. Size runs on public float because market capitalization is not populated anywhere in this dataset.

fiscal_year_end_months.title: Fiscal Year End Months
fiscal_year_end_months.description: Integers 1 to 12. Fiscal year end is effectively a United States field in this dataset.

exclude_december_fiscal_year_end.title: Exclude December Fiscal Year End
exclude_december_fiscal_year_end.description: Keep only companies whose fiscal year ends in a month other than December, the accounts whose budget cycle is out of phase with a calendar quarter.

min_cadence_confidence.title: Minimum Cadence Confidence
min_cadence_confidence.description: 0 to 1. Rows whose cadence confidence falls below this return a null timing block with a stated reason rather than a guess. Quarterly cadence averages 0.94, annual 0.40, semiannual 0.21.

event_types.title: Event Types
event_types.description: full_year_results, half_year_results, quarterly_results, trading_update, annual_report_publication, sustainability_report_publication, agm, proxy_filing, capital_markets_day.

window_lead_days.title: Outreach Window Lead Days
window_lead_days.description: How many days before the event the outreach window opens. Default 70.

window_lag_days.title: Outreach Window Lag Days
window_lag_days.description: How many days before the event the outreach window closes. Default 42. Must be less than the lead.

window_statuses.title: Window Statuses
window_statuses.description: Keep only rows in these window states: open, not_yet, closed_passed, no_event.

max_days_to_event.title: Maximum Days to Event
max_days_to_event.description: Drop rows whose next event is further away than this. A cost control.

include_constrained_period.title: Include the Constrained Announcement Period
include_constrained_period.description: Emit the period in which a listed company is constrained in what it can announce, derived from the same window numbers. Useful for campaign and announcement timing.

season_from.title: Season From
season_from.description: season mode. ISO date. Defaults to today.

season_to.title: Season To
season_to.description: season mode. ISO date. Defaults to 180 days from today.

min_provenance_confidence.title: Minimum Source Confidence
min_provenance_confidence.description: Set to high to exclude rows whose source terms were never read.

exclude_name_only_matches.title: Exclude Name Only Identity Matches
exclude_name_only_matches.description: Drop rows whose identity link rests on a name and country agreeing rather than on an identifier. Use this wherever a wrong identity link matters.

exclude_share_alike.title: Exclude Share Alike Sourced Rows
exclude_share_alike.description: Drop rows derived from CC BY-SA sources, whose share alike condition may not suit a closed product.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum rows for universe and season. Truncation is always reported, never silent.

source_tag.title: Source Tag
source_tag.description: Internal attribution tag set by Mamba Labs on published task examples. Not required, and nothing depends on it. Leave it empty.
